data.name: Aura of Putrefaction
data.description: At 8th level, a rough rampager radiates an aura that causes the wounds of enemies within 10 feet to weep blood. Injured enemies in the area take 1 point of bleed damage per round. This ability functions only while the antipaladin is conscious. This ability replaces aura of despair.
